title: First intuitive communication received in the van

tellings.quote: it was it was a while later that the first comm came and that's when it the ball started rolling, so to speak.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former US Air Force sergeant, says the NSA, the US agency that intercepts and handles secret communications, hired him to talk with aliens through his mind. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in the early 1990s, at an overseas base, he sat in a C-van, a trailer packed with communications gear, and some time later the first message came into his head. He says that was when the ball started rolling, which, if true, would mean the government had a working mental channel to non-humans.
